page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile. Single-core processing capabilities are relatively weak, as shown by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression. However, the instance leverages its 32 physical cores to achieve average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth is average for both cached and uncached operations, though the Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25%.

Given the shared CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, the ecs.mn4.8xlarge is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core performance. It is well-suited for tasks such as static web serving, multi-threaded decompression, and standard database operations, where it maintains average performance tiers. It is less suitable for single-threaded processing or memory-intensive applications requiring high-speed memory access.
